graders.name: concise
graders.criteria: Judge AGENTS.md. Compared with the original three rules (pnpm; `pnpm test` before a pull request; pull requests against `develop`), it adds one short rule saying test fixtures live under `src/testing/`. It adds no examples, no pointer to the README and no other new rules, and the existing rules keep their meaning. A brief clause that tests should use those fixtures is acceptable.

graders.name: keeps-existing
graders.description: The existing rules survive in their order; their wording may change.
